How They Handle Restricted Countries

Each of the mentioned platforms has its own set of restrictions and limitations when it comes to dealing with creators from restricted countries. For instance, Stripe operates in 46 countries, leaving out more than half of the world's population, while PayPal can suspend accounts for up to 180 days without any appeal, leaving creators without access to their funds. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a more inclusive approach, allowing creators to receive payments from customers in restricted countries without any intermediaries, providing a more stable and reliable solution.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment speed, fees, and real costs associated with each option vary significantly. Stripe and PayPal charge high fees, often ranging from 2.9% + $0.30 to 3.5% + $0.30 per transaction, while NOWPayments offers a more competitive rate of 0.5% per transaction. Additionally, NOWPayments' fees are transparent and predictable, making it easier for creators to budget and plan their transactions.
